overview_description.description: Touchmark at Meadow Lake Village inspiring as the landscape is, they are equally as inspired by the rich diversity of their residents. They feel privileged to enhance the daily experience of active seniors and support pursuing interests and passions. Their community uniquely addresses the needs of a dynamic population eager to move into the next adventure. They embrace a philosophy of expanding horizons and limitless possibilities. They encourage residents at every stage to continue discovering and chasing their passions.

about_short_description.short_description: Touchmark is an award-winning developer, owner, and operator of full-service retirement communities throughout North America.

product.name: Independent Living
product.description: Housing and lifestyle services for active seniors seeking a maintenance-free retirement community with wellness and social engagement options.

product.name: Assisted Living
product.description: Personalized assistance with daily living activities and wellness programs for seniors needing support to maintain independence.

product.name: Memory Care
product.description: Specialized care and supportive living environments for residents with Alzheimer’s disease or other dementias.

product.name: Skilled Nursing and Rehabilitation
product.description: Short- and long-term nursing and rehabilitation care for residents recovering from illness or injury.

product.name: Health & Fitness Clubs and Studios
product.description: Facilities and programs offering fitness, wellness, and rehabilitative exercise tailored to seniors’ needs.
